errors.text: The proposed bulk addition of hafnium and molybdenum does not reconstruct the target processing and oxidation-protection strategy, particularly the silicide coating responsible for the large oxidation-rate reduction.
No prior evidence is cited despite the explicit request for supporting evidence.
The alloy composition, additive concentrations, atmosphere, exposure duration, and oxygen partial pressure are unspecified.
The falsification threshold is only 'no significant improvement,' with no quantitative oxidation-rate criterion or statistical definition.
